content.stem: 在建立反金融犯罪(AFC)合规计划治理结构时,以下哪一项是需要考虑的重要因素？

options.A: 确保该结构由外部审计员或顾问进行审查
options.B: 建立与机构规模和复杂程度相适应的内部控制体系
options.C: 指定一个合格的董事会来监督日常合规情况
options.D: 明确AFC风险升级和问题处理中的角色与职责

content.stem_en: Which of the following is an important factor to consider when setting up an anti-financial crime (AFC) compliance program governance structure?

options_en.A: Ensuring the structure is reviewed by an outside auditor or consultant
options_en.B: Establishing a system of internal controls commensurate with the institution's size and complexity
options_en.C: Designating a qualified board of directors to monitor day-to-day compliance
options_en.D: Establishing clear roles and responsibilities for AFC risk escalations and issues
